settings.sub: How your book gets to you, and what to do if something's off.

settings.label: Shipping
settings.text: Shipping options and costs are shown at checkout, before you pay.

settings.label: Order updates
settings.text: You'll get an email confirming your order, and another one when it ships.

settings.label: Returns & refunds
settings.text: Returns and refunds follow our refund policy.

settings.label: Questions
settings.text: Write to us from the contact page with your order number, and we'll get back to you.

settings.label: Sending it as a gift
settings.text: Enter the recipient's address at checkout. Want to sign it yourself first? Ship it to you, then use the autograph page up front.

settings.label: Damaged or misprinted copy
settings.text: It happens, rarely. Send us a photo and your order number and we'll make it right.
